research_question: Does installing the same completed-session I7 auction state machine on BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT increase independent costed opportunities while preserving every frozen local confirmation, four-market semantic requirement, exact 3% NAV risk rule and one-slot portfolio constraint?

hypothesis.economic_cause: A completed regional session creates instrument-local external liquidity. A raid that fails through reclaim and displacement, or an accepted auction defended through FVG structure, can originate on any liquid instrument rather than BTC alone.
hypothesis.local_logic: Byte-identical Candidate 12 I7 session state machine on every symbol. Session hours, raid, reclaim, MSS/FVG, stop, target, costed-R and invalidation rules are unchanged.
hypothesis.cross_market_logic: Every emitted local session plan passes the unchanged Candidate 14 four-market semantic gate: unanimous peer transfer, causal efficiency and standardized displacement, categorical event rank and trend-role consistency.
hypothesis.opportunity_change: Only the set of instruments allowed to originate a completed I7 scenario changes from BTC alone to all four allowed markets.
hypothesis.instrument_metadata: Each bridge receives the exact tick size already used to construct its NautilusTrader instrument; no shared BTC tick is reused.
hypothesis.risk_and_execution: One GlobalCandidateMutex, one NautilusTrader account, exact current-NAV 3% planned-loss sizing, one pending-entry-or-position slot, unchanged maker/taker rates and stop/target order semantics.
hypothesis.forbidden_changes: No threshold relaxation, score multiplier, route whitelist, leverage cap, nominal cap or symbol-specific alpha parameter.

diagnostic_lineage.baseline_failure: The locked diagnostic exceeded the growth and quality gates but failed the minimum ten-trade diagnostic gate.
diagnostic_lineage.controlled_change: Session I7 origin becomes symmetric across BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP. Ordinary SCDAM and all session thresholds remain frozen.
diagnostic_lineage.purpose: Mechanism and frequency diagnosis only. W10-W14 are permanently ineligible for a final success claim.

selection.method: Controlled diagnostic reuse of the exact Candidate 14 W10-W14 intervals. No interval is selected from variant outcomes and all are permanently ineligible for final validation.

decision_rule.diagnostic_pass: All aggregate gates pass without changing any alpha threshold.
decision_rule.on_pass: Freeze fresh non-overlapping intervals before opening their market data, then run the unchanged variant in NautilusTrader.
decision_rule.on_fail: Reject symmetric session expansion. Do not tune thresholds on W10-W14.
